title: Thanksgiving Hymns (1QHa) — Hobah Translation
about: The Thanksgiving Hymns (Hodayot, 1QHa) are a collection of Hebrew hymns from Qumran. The principal scroll is heavily damaged and its column reconstruction is complex. The poems repeatedly praise God for revelation, mercy, deliverance, and the gift of understanding while describing the speaker's human frailty and conflict with hostile powers.

translation.status: Hobah provisional source-language reading translation of selected substantially preserved Hodayot units
translation.base_text: The Hebrew 1QHa manuscript tradition, following broadly accepted column and hymn-unit reconstruction while acknowledging major physical gaps
translation.method: Fresh modern-English rendering from the Hebrew sense. Because many lines are broken, this edition translates coherent preserved units rather than inventing a continuous complete scroll. Brackets and ellipses mark uncertain or missing sense.
translation.confidence: Medium-high in coherent preserved lines; low to medium where joins, column order, or restorations are disputed
translation.notes: Hymn numbering varies among editions. Labels here are descriptive reader labels rather than a claim that one modern reconstruction is certain.
translation.license_note: The ancient Hebrew manuscript is public domain. Hobah English wording is newly prepared for this project.

chapters.label: Hymn — You formed me from dust
chapters.text: I thank you, Lord, because you have made known your truth to one formed from dust. What am I, a creature of clay, that I should understand your wonderful counsel? My frame belongs to the dust and my strength fails like water, yet you placed a spirit of knowledge within me. By your mercy I stand; by your truth my steps are made firm.

chapters.label: Hymn — The mystery of your wisdom
chapters.text: I thank you, my God, because you opened my heart to the mystery of your wisdom. Hidden things are not hidden from you, and no thought comes into being apart from your knowledge. You determine the times and their appointed works. The wicked do not understand your counsel, but you give insight to the poor in spirit and teach them to walk in the way you chose.

chapters.label: Hymn — A fortified city
chapters.text: I thank you, Lord, because you made me like a fortified city against those who seek to overthrow me. They opened a lying tongue and surrounded me with accusations; terror was near and my soul sank. But you became a strong wall for me. You did not hand me over to the assembly of deceit, and the counsel of those who hated me did not stand.

chapters.label: Hymn — Pangs like a woman in labour
chapters.text: Distress seized me like the pains of a woman giving birth. Waves of destruction surrounded me, and the cords of death drew near. Yet from the anguish you brought forth hope. The one who seemed ready for the pit was raised by your hand. You turn labour into new birth and make the place of terror a doorway for praise.

chapters.label: Hymn — The fountain of life
chapters.text: I thank you because you placed within the community a fountain for those who thirst and a spring that does not fail for those who seek truth. The arrogant refuse its water because they do not recognize its source. But the humble drink and receive understanding. Your teaching becomes life within them, and their fruit is for healing rather than deceit.

chapters.label: Hymn — The spirits of truth
chapters.text: Blessed are you, God of knowledge, for you examine every spirit and know the inclination of every heart. Nothing can hide from your judgment. You strengthen the spirit that seeks truth and expose the spirit of deceit. Purify me from a divided heart, so that my words and my deeds may belong to one path before you.

chapters.label: Hymn — Among the heavenly council
chapters.text: I thank you, Lord, because you allowed a mortal creature to speak of the praise of your holy ones. The heavenly host blesses your glorious name, and the spirits appointed to knowledge stand in their stations. A human being cannot equal them, yet by your mercy the poor may join their praise and learn the order of holiness.

chapters.label: Hymn — Rescue from the pit
chapters.text: I was counted as one descending to the pit. My strength left me, my companions drew back, and my enemies said that my hope had perished. Then you heard the cry of the afflicted. You lifted my soul from destruction and placed my feet on firm ground. Therefore I will proclaim your faithfulness among those who know your covenant.

chapters.label: Hymn — Knowledge is your gift
chapters.text: No one becomes righteous by human wisdom alone, and no flesh can establish its own way. Understanding comes from you. You teach the ear, open the heart, and give the tongue its answer. I know that whatever truth is found in me is your gift, while error belongs to the weakness of flesh. Let me not boast in what I received by mercy.

chapters.label: Hymn — Against the congregation of deceit
chapters.text: Those who build their counsel on falsehood dig a pit for themselves. Their speech is smooth, but violence is hidden within it. They mock the one who walks simply and call darkness light. Yet you, Lord, know the end from the beginning. Their secret plans are open before you, and at the appointed time their refuge of lies will fall.

chapters.label: Hymn — Everlasting mercy
chapters.text: I thank you because your mercy is greater than my weakness. If you counted every failure, who formed from dust could stand? You cleanse according to your abundant compassion and lead the one who returns to you. Your rebuke is not like human hatred; you correct in order to establish. Therefore my hope rests in your kindness and not in the strength of my own hand.

chapters.label: Hymn — Praise at the appointed times
chapters.text: I will bless you at the changing of light and darkness, at the coming of morning and at the watches of night. I will remember your wonders when the seasons turn and when the appointed festivals arrive. All times belong to your wisdom. Let my tongue not be silent while breath remains in me, for you are the God who gives life, knowledge, and peace to those who seek you.
